question: Does compact RADIO capacity, rather than typed object readout, explain the remaining LERF gap?

gpu_execution.reason: All required evidence was already materialized. GPU4 had 17148/24564 MiB allocated and 86 percent utilization; a new long field build was neither needed nor safe.

same_contract.readout: unchanged VALA kNN10, raw-smoothed-peak scale selection, per-level min-max, fixed 0.6 threshold, selected-only-alpha projection
same_contract.evaluation: OpenGaussian-style LERF direct 3D primitive selection on the same four official Figurines frames

matched_source_capacity_edge.same_contract: same source-only top1 lifting cohort, trainable PCA-initialized affine basis, 20 epochs, raw/DINO/SAM gates; benchmark targets unopened

missing_matched_edge.edge: D512/L512 versus exact MPR under the same current identity-extent posterior and identical row authority
why_not_comparable: The current Method-v1 primitive query cache is hash-bound to the 2026-08-15 generic-response D512 field, not either 2026-08-05 arm.
The materialized old D512 exact-MPR query cache has 96879 valid rows, whereas the existing exact-teacher same-readout cache has 82603 rows.
The D256/L128 checkpoint is top1-lifted with 34669 valid rows; no D256/L128 checkpoint exists under the exact-marginal visibility-safe 96879-row authority.
Therefore mixing the three reported rows would change lifting, support, field stage, and readout identity simultaneously.
missing_matched_edge.required_to_close: Materialize D512 and exact teacher query scores from one frozen row-domain compiler, or intersect both to a predeclared common row authority. A true D256 exact-MPR arm would require a new field build and was intentionally not started.

known_steps.compact: exact/top1 observation lifting, PCA/basis fit, 20-epoch factorized field optimization, query-score materialization
known_steps.exact_teacher: exact marginal observation lifting and direct query-score materialization; no field optimization

construction_cost.wall_time: Historical logs do not contain authoritative elapsed time; filesystem mtimes are not used as runtime measurements.

conclusion.capacity_selection: D512/L512 remains justified as the smallest registered capacity that passes all source-only capability gates.
conclusion.benchmark_bottleneck: Even replacing a D256/L128 compact descriptor by the full exact 1280-D MPR teacher improves matched Figurines LERF3D mIoU by only 0.00467. Thus compact feature capacity is not the dominant benchmark bottleneck.
conclusion.next_action: Do not spend GPUs on D256 retraining now. Prioritize learned object affinity/tracks and typed object posterior; close the exact-D512 edge later as a paper ablation with one frozen compiler.
